entry.title: Culture, 24 July
entry.content:
Culture

How Conor Oberst Survived Teenage Rock Stardom

NYT > Arts > Music

A long profile of Conor Oberst on three decades as a cult singer-songwriter, his personal struggles and writing political songs under Trump.

A substantial piece on a songwriter whose confessional, piano-adjacent tradition sits close to his taste.

Bonnie Tyler, zangeres van ‘Total Eclipse of the Heart’ op 75-jarige leeftijd overleden

Muziek - KnackFocus

Bonnie Tyler, singer of 'Total Eclipse of the Heart', has died at 75.

An obituary of a musician he would know from the pop canon.

Van Baby Rose tot Joey Alexander: de pop- en jazzalbums van de week

De Standaard - Cultuur en media

De Standaard's weekly pick of the best pop and jazz albums, including Baby Rose and pianist Joey Alexander.

A quick weekly scan for new jazz and piano releases in his wheelhouse.

Een mix van piano en Perzische percussie, en een van de beste Franse pianisten: de beste klassieke albums van het moment

De Standaard - Cultuur en media

De Standaard's roundup of the best current classical albums, featuring a piano-and-Persian-percussion project and a leading French pianist.

Piano-centred classical picks that fit his listening habits.

De film ‘Los Domingos’ getuigt van zeldzame intellectuele nieuwsgierigheid

Film - KnackFocus

A review of the Spanish film Los domingos, about a teenage girl choosing a religious life against her family's wishes.

An arthouse title praised for real intellectual curiosity, worth reading before deciding to see it.

‘The Odyssey’ is een zeldzaam beest van een blockbuster

Film - KnackFocus

A Dutch-language review of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey, weighing its scale against its shortcomings.

A critical assessment of a major director's new blockbuster, for someone who follows serious cinema writing.
